tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind panels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, header bar, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Plot areas inside a panel: the star map, charts, code-like logs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tab track, table row hover, pressed secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Panel outlines, input borders, table header rule.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Row dividers, map grid lines, separators inside a panel.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline and control borders that must reach 3:1 against surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy in news items, descriptions, inactive tab labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text: units, timestamps, column headers, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: YOU: your systems, your fleets, primary actions, links, active tab, selection.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent buttons and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table row, accent badge fill, comms-range shading on the map.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: OTHERS and attention: other civilizations, incoming fleets, items needing a decision. Always paired with a shape or label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Signal badge fill, highlighted 'decision needed' rows.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains, treaties in force, completed research. Text on surface.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Positive badge fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (declare war, abandon colony) and errors. Rare; always with an explicit label because it sits close to signal in hue.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error field background, danger badge fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on every interactive element.

tokens.name: star-k
tokens.usage: Map glyph tint for K and G stars. Decorative; never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: star-m
tokens.usage: Map glyph tint for M dwarfs. Decorative.

tokens.name: star-hot
tokens.usage: Map glyph tint for F, A, B and O stars. Decorative.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The lowercase wordmark in the header and login page.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Screen title or the lead panel on a screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Oceans under a thin nitrogen sky, 4.1 ly from Hearth.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Never smaller for running prose.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, column headers, legend items. The smallest text size allowed.

styles.name: data-md
styles.usage: Every number in a table or stat block. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Panel meta lines and the status bar.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Category tags above news items and map labels. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a panel, between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding, the gap between panels and the page gutter.

tokens.usage: Gap between major columns on the login page.

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, panels, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tab track, popovers, the login card.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: App header height.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs (desktop, pointer use).

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside table rows and panel headers. 24px is the WCAG 2.2 minimum target; never go smaller.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Minimum data-table row height.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Right-hand detail column on game screens.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, tooltips and menus only. Panels use borders, not shadows.
